# AGENTS.md — rtifact-platform-installer

Instructions for humans and AI agents working in this repository.

## Runtime

- **OpenTofu only.** Use the `tofu` CLI (`plan`, `apply`, `destroy`, `validate`, `fmt`, `init`). Never invoke HashiCorp Terraform (`terraform`).
- The Go installer (`cmd/installer`) only executes `tofu`.

## Provider sources

- Pin providers from the **[OpenTofu Registry](https://search.opentofu.org/providers)** only.
- Use the **`opentofu/` namespace** (e.g. `opentofu/azurerm`, `opentofu/random`, `opentofu/tls`), not `hashicorp/*`.
- Versions are declared in each module/stack `providers.tofu` inside `terraform { required_providers { ... } }` (OpenTofu settings block syntax).
- On `tofu init`, the registry may show informational notes comparing `opentofu/*` and `hashicorp/*` namespaces; **ignore those** — this project standardizes on `opentofu/*`.

## Configuration files

- **Do not add new `.tf` files.** All OpenTofu configuration must use the **`.tofu`** extension (e.g. `main.tofu`, `variables.tofu`, `providers.tofu`).
- Variable files for customers stay **YAML** (e.g. `<customer>-<env>-<purpose>.yaml` **external** to the repo).
- Customer contract (schema v2): top-level `cloud`, `account`, `workload`, and `features.*` booleans (validated against the profile registry).
- Generated at apply time: `installer.auto.tfvars.json` (passed via `-var-file`) and `backend.tofu` (from `cloud.Backend()`); local state lives under `~/.rtifact-installer/<prefix>/state/`.
- New IaC modules/resources must be behind a `features.<name>` flag in the stack.

## Layout

- `infra/modules/<cloud>/` — reusable building blocks (`providers.tofu` + `*.tofu`).
- `infra/stacks/<profile>/<cloud>/<layer>/` — composition roots; **only stacks** configure cloud provider blocks (`azurerm`, `aws`, `google`).
- `profiles/` — workload defaults (not customer-specific).
- Customer values live **outside** this repo.

## When changing IaC

1. Match provider schemas for your cloud ([azurerm 5.x](https://search.opentofu.org/provider/opentofu/azurerm/latest), [aws](https://search.opentofu.org/provider/opentofu/aws/latest), [google](https://search.opentofu.org/provider/opentofu/google/latest)); avoid deprecated arguments (e.g. storage account uses `public_network_access`, not `public_network_access_enabled`).
2. Run `make tofu-pre-commit-fast` (or `tofu fmt -recursive infra/` and `make tofu-validate`).
3. Update `infra/stacks/<profile>/<cloud>/<layer>/.terraform.lock.hcl` when provider versions change (`tofu init -upgrade` in the stack dir or `make tofu-pre-commit` to refresh locks).
4. Run `make package-content` before release builds.

## Build

```bash
make build-dev
make tofu-validate
./dist/rtifact validate examples/sandbox.yaml
```

Release: `make release` (embeds OpenTofu + provider mirror).
## Scope

- **This repo** — product installer, embedded IaC, Go CLI, profiles, customer contract schema.
- **Templates** — canonical checkout `/Users/raghavendiran/cipherops-io/boilerplates` ([`cipherops-io/boilerplates`](https://github.com/cipherops-io/boilerplates) on GitHub): `devops-templates/platform-installer`, `_installer-core`. See boilerplates `AGENTS.md` and `docs/WORKSPACE-ROOTS.md`.

## Managed vs init-only files

| Kind | Examples | Edit where |
|------|-----------|------------|
| **Managed** (regenerated by `make boilerplate-update`) | `boilerplate.mk`, composed `AGENTS.md`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.terraform-docs.yml` | Boilerplates partials / `_installer-core`, then `make boilerplate-update` |
| **Init-only** | `infra/**/*.tofu`, Go code, `docs/customer-runbook.md`, README prose **above** `<!-- BEGIN_TF_DOCS -->` | This repo (backport template changes when needed) |

**Rule:** Do not add recurring make/docs/CI targets to the init-only `Makefile` — they belong in `boilerplates/partials/makefile/` → `boilerplate.mk`.

## Makefile targets

| Target | Fix or check | When |
|--------|----------------|------|
| `make tofu-pre-commit-fast` | Fix | Default after IaC/docs edits (fmt, module docs, `go fmt`, `go mod tidy`) |
| `make tofu-pre-commit` | Fix | Provider version bumps — also refreshes stack `.terraform.lock.hcl` files |
| `make tofu-test-fast` | Check | Quick PR sanity (fmt check, module validate, unit tests) |
| `make tofu-test` | Check | CI: fast checks + stack validate + example config validate |
| `make tofu-docs` | Fix | Regenerate README `BEGIN_TF_DOCS` via `build/scripts/terraform-docs-module.sh` (temp `.tf` copies only — upstream terraform-docs cannot parse `.tofu` yet). Do **not** run `terraform-docs` directly on modules. |
| `make boilerplate-update` | Fix | Sync managed files from `platform-installer` template |

Install tooling: `tofu` (pinned in build scripts), `terraform-docs` (see `vars/versions.yml` → `TerraformDocsVersion`), Gruntwork `boilerplate` CLI for template sync.

## Where to edit

| Task | Path |
|------|------|
| New reusable module | `infra/modules/<cloud>/<name>/` + wire in stack under `infra/stacks/aios-infra/<cloud>/<layer>/` |
| Feature flag | `profiles/aios-infra/features.yaml`, schema, stack `count`/`local` gates |
| Azure / AWS / GCP pack | Mirror changes across `azure`, `aws`, `gcp` trees when the capability is shared |
| Customer contract | `schemas/customer-config.schema.json` (boilerplates mirror) — values stay **outside** repo |
| Installer behavior | `internal/`, `cmd/installer` |
| Template / managed make targets | `boilerplates` → `make boilerplate-update` here |

See also [docs/adding-a-profile.md](docs/adding-a-profile.md), [docs/layer-contracts.md](docs/layer-contracts.md), [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md).

## When things go wrong

| Symptom | What to do |
|---------|------------|
| `Module not installed` / provider errors | `cd` affected stack, `tofu init -backend=false`; or `make tofu-pre-commit` if locks stale |
| `terraform-docs` / `--output-check` failed | `make tofu-docs`, review `git diff '**/README.md'` |
| Stack `validate` fails | Compare provider docs; check `depends_on` and feature flags; [layer-contracts.md](docs/layer-contracts.md) |
| Example `validate` fails | `make build-dev`, fix `examples/*.yaml` or merge/schema |
| Azure E2E / OIDC | [docs/azure-github-oidc-e2e.md](docs/azure-github-oidc-e2e.md) |
| `boilerplate-update` overwrote a fix | Backport to boilerplates partials, re-run update |

## Multi-cloud

- Default packaged clouds: `PACKAGED_CLOUDS=azure,aws,gcp` (`Makefile` / release builds).
- `make tofu-validate` and stack locks iterate `infra/stacks/aios-infra/{azure,aws,gcp}/<layer>/`.
- See [docs/adr/0009-multicloud-state-and-naming.md](docs/adr/0009-multicloud-state-and-naming.md).

## Backport rule

Edits to managed files in this repo are **temporary**. Permanently fix in `cipherops-io/boilerplates`, then run `make boilerplate-update` here. Permanently fix composed installer docs/make targets in `boilerplates/partials/*` and `templates/installer-managed/`, then `make sync-installer-managed` in boilerplates (or `make verify`).
